opportunities.name: End-to-end city weekend trip planning
opportunities.description: For a given {city, dates, guests, activity themes, cuisine, recipient}, look up the city on Wikipedia and timeanddate, find a hotel on Booking.com, find activities on Viator, find a dinner on OpenTable, save a summary note and email the plan.
opportunities.site: wikipedia.org, timeanddate.com, booking.com, viator.com, opentable.com, notes/mail app
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and note the population
Search the city on timeanddate and note the current weather
On Booking.com, enter the destination, check-in/out dates and occupancy, search, and open the chosen hotel
On Viator, search each activity theme for the city and pick the top result
On OpenTable, enter '<city> <cuisine>' and the dinner date, click Find a table, and pick the top restaurant
Add a note: '<city> <dates>: pop, temp, hotel, activities, dinner <restaurant> <time>'
Compose an email to the recipient with subject '<city> weekend <dates>' and the plan in the body

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15, 2 adults, Thames boat + Tower of London, Indian (Benares 18:30), maya@example.com
Dublin, Dec 4-6, 3 adults, Guinness Storehouse + Cliffs of Moher (no notes or email seen)
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17, 2 adults, whisky tasting + Highlands day trip, Scottish (Evergreen Bar & Kitchen 18:30), priya@example.com

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search for city and dates
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com stays for {destination} with {check-in, check-out, adults}, then open a chosen property's details.
steps: Dismiss the cookie or sign-in popups if they appear
Click the destination field, type the city, and pick the city suggestion
Open the date picker, navigate to the month, and click the check-in and check-out days
Open occupancy and adjust adults with +/-, then click Done
Click Search
Click a property in the results and open Info & prices

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15, 2 adults; opened voco London Camden Lock
Dublin, Dec 4-6, 3 adults; opened Maldron Hotel Smithfield
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17, 2 adults; opened Stylish Leith Residence

opportunities.name: Viator activity search
opportunities.description: On Viator, search a {activity query} for a city, submit the search, and open the top result.
steps: Reject the cookies if prompted
Click the 'Where to?' search box and clear any previous text
Type '<activity> <city>'
Click 'Search for <query>' (or a suggestion)
Review the results and open the top card

opportunities.name: OpenTable restaurant search by city, cuisine and date
opportunities.description: On OpenTable, search '{city} {cuisine}' for {date} and pick the top restaurant and time slot.
steps: Reject the non-essential cookies if prompted
Type '<city> <cuisine>' in the Location/Restaurant/Cuisine field
Open the date picker, go to the target month, and click the day
Click Let's go / Find a table
Select the top restaurant result

instances.values: Edinburgh Scottish, Jan 15 2027 → Evergreen Bar & Kitchen

opportunities.name: timeanddate city weather lookup
opportunities.description: On timeanddate.com, search a {city} and read its current time and weather.
steps: Deny the cookie consent if shown
Type the city in the 'Search for city or place' box
Select the matching city suggestion or submit the search
Open the Weather tab and read the current temperature

opportunities.name: Wikipedia city article lookup
opportunities.description: Search Wikipedia for a {city} and open its article to read facts such as population.
steps: Dismiss the fundraising banner if shown
Type the city into Search Wikipedia
Click the city suggestion
Read the infobox (population)

opportunities.name: Email trip plan to a friend
opportunities.description: Compose a new message to {recipient} with subject '{city} weekend {dates}' and a body summarising the hotel, activities and dinner.
steps: Open New message
Type the recipient address in To
Type the subject '<city> weekend <dates>'
Type the body 'Hi <name>, plan: hotel <hotel> (<price>), <activities>, dinner at <restaurant> (<cuisine>) on <date>.'
Click Send (the recording shows the Discard button being clicked)

opportunities.name: Save trip summary note
opportunities.description: Add a note in the Notes app summarising a {city} trip: dates, population, weather, hotel, activities and dinner.
steps: Open Notes
Click the New note field
Type '<city> <dates>: pop <n>, <temp>, hotel <hotel>, <activities>, dinner <restaurant> <time>'
Press Enter to save

instances.values: London Nov 13-15, voco Camden Lock, Thames cruise, Tower of London, Benares 18:30
Edinburgh, Stylish Leith, Highlands and Glencoe day trip, Evergreen Bar & Kitchen 18:30
